widgets_values: FLUX.3 Klein Base text to image: 1024x1024, 25 steps, CFG 3.5, Euler and the simple scheduler, the vendor's ComfyUI settings. Try 50 steps for more detail, the model card's default; 25 and 50 both divide the sigma table ComfyUI builds, so the schedule stays on the vendor's. ComfyUI's native shift is the vendor's; add no shift node. Dimensions must be multiples of 16, and multiples of 32 keep both grid axes even. The negative is the encoding of an empty prompt, as the vendor's reference code uses. FLUX takes no negative prompt: describe what you want instead of what to leave out. The vendor's prompt guide asks for a full caption of about 100 to 350 words: medium and style first, then scene, lighting and camera, then each subject with its colors, materials and place in the frame. Describe what is there, not what is absent, and put any text to render in double quotes. The sample prompt is shorter than that guide asks; write a full caption for your own renders. The vendor's own graphs can run an optional prompt upsampler, qwen3.5_9b_flux3_prompt_upsampler_int8_convrot.safetensors, which rewrites a short request into such a caption on the driver; its 9.7 GB is outside dgx-monarch's driver memory estimate. The stock Flux3 Layout Prompt node turns bounding boxes into prompt text. Either can feed CLIP Text Encode with no change to this graph. The INT8 ConvRot files pin an approximate attention kernel: single, cfg2 and dp2 ask for the Sol-Attn waiver, and uly2 drops the pin. This graph uses the BF16 files, which ask nothing. Auto picks Ulysses on a configured pair. In the 2026-10-15 hardware tests, uly2 renders of this graph matched stock ComfyUI on one GPU exactly; see docs/VALIDATION.md#evidence-flux-3-klein for the scope. Expects flux3_image_klein_bf16.safetensors in models/diffusion_models, qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors in models/text_encoders (CLIP type flux3) and flux2-vae.safetensors in models/vae; the vendor's vae/flux2-vae.safetensors holds the same weights in another key layout. Needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer on the driver and every Worker. The FLUX.3 Image Klein weights are under the FLUX Kommunity License v1.0; read its terms before commercial use. The Qwen3-VL encoder is Apache-2.0. The first render of a new model runs the identity gate, comparing the mesh with a stock single-GPU load before producing pixels. Allow a few minutes for proof renders. Later renders of the same combination skip the gate. This graph is derived from the family adapter and stock node definitions, without a committed reference render. Check filenames and shapes against your artifacts before running it.

widgets_values: A color photograph taken at eye level with a 50 mm lens. A small ceramics studio in late afternoon: sunlight falls through a tall window on the left and lights a scarred wooden workbench. On the bench sit three hand-thrown bowls with a speckled oatmeal glaze, a wire cutting tool and a folded grey cloth. A potter's wheel stands in soft shadow behind them, its tray streaked with dried clay. Shelves on the back wall hold rows of unglazed cups. Warm tones, gentle contrast, shallow depth of field, the bowls in sharp focus.
